source_crosschecks.result: Realtime _stern() dispatches in-process and maps gespraech-erinnerung-schreiben directly to stern.gespraech_erinnerung_schreiben; the low-latency memory-write path does not traverse Claude Code PreToolUse/PostToolUse.

frank_auftrag_stellen has a real pre-dispatch two-call confirmation gate: same normalized text, bestaetigt=true, a new server-transcribed user utterance, <=300s age and no keyword contradiction are required before self.auftrag.stellen().

claude_frage() delegates confirmed voice work to headless Claude Code and unconditionally disables the whole Bash tool via --disallowedTools, while file tools remain available; source alone does not prove exact plugin/hook loading for the spawned process.

semantic_atoms.claim: Realtime durable conversation-memory writes are direct narrow in-process writes to the canonical substrate and bypass the Claude Code effect-hook lifecycle. This is a distinct STATE_WRITE class, not evidence of a second world-effect authority.

Voice Auftrag dispatch has a genuine causally-prior confirmation gate, but identity is currently normalized text plus session-local counters/timing rather than immutable audio/transcript/effect IDs; speaker attribution remains explicitly incomplete.

Confirmed voice jobs are delegated asynchronously to claude -p. Bash is hard-disabled, but file tools remain and the source does not establish that every spawned process loads an exact shared blocking hook configuration. Final authority therefore cannot depend on assumed plugin lifecycle reachability.

The donor has heterogeneous control surfaces: direct typed memory writes, voice-specific confirmation, delegated Claude Code tool execution, nonblocking stern effect bookkeeping and historical Bash-only wache enforcement. No source-proven single cross-modal current EffectGate exists across them.

architecture_deltas.delta: Separate MEMORY_WRITE_ADMISSION/STATE_WRITE_ADMISSION from WORLD_EFFECT_ADMISSION while keeping one canonical durable state substrate. Realtime memory writes require provenance, generation, causal identity and policy, but not the same human confirmation semantics as external world effects.

Compile voice proposal/confirmation into a typed EffectRequest plus EffectDecision bound to Realtime call_id, immutable audio/transcript causal IDs, session/generation, normalized request digest and explicit confirmation evidence. Preserve ASK/WAIT when identity or intent is insufficient.

Place canonical enforcement below modality/plugin-specific front gates so text, voice, GRID and delegated Claude Code all converge on one immutable effect identity before actual file/world dispatch. Plugin hooks may add defence-in-depth but cannot be the sole correctness premise.

Asynchronous delegated jobs must preserve request/effect identity through submission, execution, outcome verification and later conversation/GWT re-entry; background completion text alone cannot mint completion or world truth.

contradictions.claim_a: Voice has a genuine pre-dispatch confirmation gate and Bash is disabled in delegated Claude Code.
contradictions.claim_b: Direct memory writes and remaining file-tool effects use different authority paths, and exact spawned-hook reachability is unproven.
contradictions.resolution_rule: Preserve modality-specific front gates but compile them into one typed state/effect authority and immutable causal identity at the final executor boundary.

hypotheses: The donor's voice confirmation is a valuable pre-dispatch primitive if identity is upgraded from text/counters to typed audio/transcript/effect evidence.

A low-latency Realtime path does not require bypassing canonical authority; deterministic in-process state admission can remain fast while external effects converge at a lower shared executor boundary.
counterhypotheses: The spawned Claude Code process may already load normal hooks and host permissions; exact settings/runtime evidence could reduce the implementation delta but would not remove the need for immutable cross-modal effect identity.
Memory writes may legitimately use a lighter policy than world effects; convergence must preserve distinct operation classes rather than forcing every write through human confirmation.
critical_unknowns: Exact plugin/settings/hook reachability and ordering for claude_frage() spawned headless Claude Code.
Any Realtime function path beyond dedicated memory and confirmed Auftrag that can mutate external state directly.
Exact mapping Realtime call_id/audio/transcript event -> proposal -> confirmation -> delegated Claude tool_use_id -> EffectDecision -> execution/outcome receipt.
Current non-Bash file-tool enforcement below the delegated Claude Code layer.
triggerword4_acceptance_tests: First voice proposal never dispatches an external effect.
Second confirmation must bind to the exact immutable proposal/audio/transcript identity; stale, mismatched or contradicted confirmation fails closed.
Delegated file mutation consumes the same one-shot EffectDecision identity at final dispatch even if Claude Code hooks are absent.
Direct Realtime memory write receives typed STATE_WRITE admission/provenance and cannot escalate to WORLD_EFFECT authority.
Async completion re-enters only with the exact original effect identity and explicit outcome state; unknown stays UNKNOWN.
next_exact_gate: Resolve claude_frage spawned-process hook/settings reachability and current non-Bash file-tool enforcement, then hand Triggerword-4 a cross-modal typed EffectRequest/Decision ABI with voice causal confirmation, fast typed memory admission and executor-level DENY/nonexecution plus async re-entry tests.
